summary: Push C day. He's skipped breakfast repeatedly, so today it's pure grab-and-go (shake, bagel, cold turkey, berries) with no eggs required. No wellness-bar protein smoothie on today's menu, so an Evolve shake fills in. Lunch stays with a chicken main but swaps in the Soft Tofu Stew for variety; dinner switches to Bread Crusted Ling Cod (fish) for a change after several straight days of chicken-only mains, chosen for its high protein and fiber.
